measurements.cpu: CDP Performance timeDomain=threadTicks; TaskDuration, ScriptDuration, ThreadTime deltas. Workload includes explicit flush and HTTP completion; forced GC excluded.
measurements.memory: Separate post-warmup phase: no active client -> initialized -> one unflushed batch -> flushed. Full GC before each JS usedSize reading; RSS is summed renderer process RSS from ps, not SDK-owned memory or peak.
measurements.traffic: Actual uncompressed collector HTTP request-body bytes only; excludes headers/TCP/TLS, SDK download and fixture /ok,/fail requests.
measurements.order: Four-mode balanced Latin-square rotation by repetition, scenario order rotated by repetition. Fresh browser process for every cell. One 20%-sized warmup in the same page, discarded.

options.otherOptions: Defaults; capture flags, sampling, dedupe and limits not overridden.

limitations: Synthetic local workload, not a production CPU percentage or a device-wide measurement.
No CPU/network throttling; host is shared with other apps.
Forced-GC retained heap is not allocation rate or peak memory.
Console strings and browser networking have their own costs, included in the SDK-absent control.
